nora: Quick coord: planning a small-batch rename + backfill tomorrow night in the 01:00-01:30 UTC quiet window. keeping it minimal but want image pin + escape-hatch checks.

deploybot: maintenance window reserved: 2024-08-02 01:00->01:30 UTC. job: smallbatch_rename_backfill_v1. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/smallbatch-rename :white_check_mark:

vik: this uses temp-table copy for rows matching predicate, then swap via rename. swap holds brief metadata lock (~50-150ms). we will rate-limit to 2k rows/min and pause between batches.

db-admin: note: replicas sometimes return schema-apply warning under high DDL churn; ops-bot preflight will verify schema sync <100ms.

alice: pin request: migration-runner@sha256:ff1122 and rename-tool@sha256:aa3344. set feature flag `enable_smallbatch_rename` to OFF until canary unpaused.

deploybot: pins applied and flag OFF. will annotate unpause message when posted.

deploybot: paused at canary checkpoint. awaiting manual continue.

vik: checks look good, no lock spikes, proceed to ramp.

deploybot: ramping to full with controlled batches. reporting every 3m.

alice: will draft internal note: "Small-batch rename/backfill: minimal lock window; conservative throttles; escape-hatch validated." leaving thread open 45m for delayed checks. thanks team. :party:
